nodes.label: Cyber Wellness Quest (App)
nodes.rationale: A walkable cyber wellness game for ages 7-12. The player is a Traveler with a paper journal; Comet shows them the Atlas. Built from design.md (visual system) and storyline.md (world and script), as a React/Vite app.

nodes.label: Walkable Realm Scene
nodes.rationale: Each realm is a 2D scene walked with arrow keys/WASD, interacted with via Space/Enter at a pin. Each step (story, decision, mini-game, rule) moves the pin, and the scene itself changes once the safe choice is made - the vault opens, the fog lifts, the water clears, the tide goes out.

nodes.label: Ground Rule: scene_y = world_y x 2.8
nodes.rationale: Scene art (560x280 viewBox in RealmArt.jsx) and the walkable band (0-100 world units in data/realms.js) live in two coordinate systems and nothing enforces that they agree. Two rules follow: solid ground must be drawn across the entire walkable band in both moods, and nothing solid may float above the band, because World.jsx draws the Traveler over the scene with no depth sorting. Breaking either has already produced real bugs - a campfire burning on open water, a Traveler walking across a bog.

nodes.label: Scene Contact Sheet (#art)
nodes.rationale: A dev-only route showing every realm in both moods at once with the walkable band and hotspots overlaid - the fastest way to check the ground rules, beating walking to all sixteen corners by hand. Nothing links to it.

nodes.label: No Fail State, Warm Redirect
nodes.rationale: Nothing can be failed. Picking the unsafe option gets a warm redirect from Comet and hands the decision straight back - no dead end, no timer, and no score shown to the player.

nodes.label: Step Panel Portal to Body
nodes.rationale: The step panel renders through a portal to <body> because .fold animates a perspective()/rotateY() transform, which makes it a containing block - a position:fixed scrim inside it would resolve against the realm card instead of the viewport. Panel action rows are sticky to the bottom, because a long story beat can otherwise push the only way forward below the fold and a child who cannot see the button is simply stuck.

nodes.label: Known Deviations from the Design Docs
nodes.rationale: Three deliberate calls logged so docs and build do not quietly drift: a walkable world instead of design.md section 5's point-and-click cards; a real Vite app with localStorage persistence instead of section 9's single-file artifact; and a third mini-game component, because section 5's own 'Balance the Day' is a scale rather than two bins - it reuses Sort's exact click-to-place controls so there is no new control to learn.
